title: Aaron Bell and musical families of Muskogee
summary: Allen asks about Aaron Bell's New Orleans mother and families from Muskogee; Albert does not know the Bells.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You know, I found out something this morning. At least I read it in the book. I don't know if it's true or not. It said Aaron Bell's mother was from New Orleans.
He's a bass player with Duke Ellington.
Yeah, there was a lot of Bells. I thought he was an Okie from Muskogee, you know.
Yeah, but I never really would. You don't know any Bells from Muskogee?
No. They had a whole family. She was a music teacher.
No, you got the wrong person. You talking about Pettiford?
Well, he was from there too. Oscar Pettiford? Yeah. I don't know the Bell.
You don't know the Bell family.
I know there are a lot of musical families around there.
